checks: Two compiled repair mutants, exact restoration and paired source syntax
cost: Let B be input bytes, R rows, W syntactic words and F feature parse work. read costs O(B+F) plus file-wide token counters and O(B+W) retained projection storage. Doc parse/text and refresh are linear in traversed bytes/rows plus gram parsing and cloning; exact enum parser costs are delegated. Atomic refresh adds an O(R) temporary index vector alongside old derived views. No dimension cap or fallible allocation interface; usize counters/length arithmetic have no separate overflow certificate.
description: Three deliberately different views: read projects a UTF-8 file permissively to syntactic-word Sentence values; FullSentence retains raw rows/comments plus explicitly refreshed derived words/sent; Doc parses a stricter LF/column/comment grammar and serializes retained raw data exactly when unedited. No function establishes a dependency tree. Tokens keep mapped gram enums and parsed known features; serde views omit raw unknown fields.
forward: Three deliberately different views: read projects a UTF-8 file permissively to syntactic-word Sentence values; FullSentence retains raw rows/comments plus explicitly refreshed derived words/sent; Doc parses a stricter LF/column/comment grammar and serializes retained raw data exactly when unedited. No function establishes a dependency tree. Tokens keep mapped gram enums and parsed known features; serde views omit raw unknown fields.
inverse: Doc::parse(t)?.text()==t uniquely recovers accepted original bytes from an unedited parsed Doc; there is no converse for arbitrary publicly mutable Doc structures. Sentence projections have many antecedents: different DEPS/MISC, comments, unknown features, range/empty rows and malformed heads mapping to zero can share one view. Existing sent/words alone cannot reconstruct raw rows.
limitations: Permissive read differs from strict Doc grammar
Neither parser proves valid dependency trees
No corpus or timing run, no allocation/I/O fault injection
Partial lexical syntax, no semantic proof or executable surrogate
state: Raw UTF-8 lines, comments/columns/blank metadata and independently refreshed derived token/index views
